title: SurvFitSummary 2.0.0
text: Version 2.0.0 redesigns package: functions version 1.0.0 replaced . processing_dataset() keeps covariate stratification columns (column_covariates, column_strata), returns ARM factor control arm (control_arm) first level, checks times positive indicator contains 0 1, removes rows missing values warning, also reads SAS transport (.xpt) files. CSV files read utils::read.csv(). generate_dummy_survival_data() restores random number generator state session (simulated values unchanged). New summarise_data(): numbers patients, events censored observations, median confidence interval, arm. New km_table(): Kaplan-Meier estimates standard errors confidence intervals, numbers risk, events censored observations regular times. New estimate_hazard_ratio(): hazard ratios unadjusted, adjusted, unstratified stratified Cox models, control arm reference (version 1.0.0 reference arm Cox model follow control_arm). New test_proportional_hazards(): Grambsch-Therneau test proportional hazards. New estimate_empirical_hazard(): smoothed empirical hazard arm bshazard::bshazard(). New fit_survival_models() replaces fitting_surv_mod() fitting_surv_mod_multiple(): fits parametric Royston-Parmar spline models , arm arms arm covariate, returns object class survfitsummary used tables. Twelve distributions available (exponential, Weibull accelerated failure time proportional hazards forms, Rayleigh, lognormal, log-logistic, Gompertz, gamma, generalized gamma generalized F, also original parameterisation); default seven standard models NICE DSU TSD 14. Spline models hazard, odds normal scales 1 3 knots quantiles log event times times given user. model fails warns recorded message models still fitted; optimiser uses smaller tolerance (reltol = 1e-10) , spline models normal scale, whose gradient flexsurv computes numerically, smaller step numerical gradient (ndeps = 1e-5). Print-ready model names (example “Log-logistic”, “Generalized Gamma”, “Hazards, 2 knots”). New parameter_table(): estimates, standard errors confidence intervals natural transformed scales. New covariance_table(): covariance matrices lower triangular Cholesky factors transformed natural (delta method) scales (version 1.0.0 Cholesky factor upper triangular). New gof_table(): log-likelihood, AIC BIC sorted AIC; fixed shape Rayleigh model counted. New predict_survival(): survival, hazard cumulative hazard given times arm, simulated confidence limits (seed, without changing random number generator session) Kaplan-Meier estimate, NA largest observed time arm. New survival_summary(): median, mean restricted mean survival. New spline_knot_table(): placement knots number risk Kaplan-Meier estimate knot. plot_km(): Kaplan-Meier curves numbers risk; curve ends largest observed time arm (version 1.0.0 curves extended longest arm). plot_empirical_hazard(): smoothed empirical hazard without fitted models. plot_survival_fits() plot_hazard_fits(): Kaplan-Meier curve smoothed empirical hazard fitted parametric spline models, extrapolated time horizon, one arm several models one model several arms (independent dependent fits). plot_distribution_diagnostics(): log(-log S(t)), log-odds probit Kaplan-Meier estimate log time, log smoothed hazard time (version 1.0.0 Gompertz plot used log(-log S(t)) time, linear Gompertz). plot_schoenfeld(): reference line estimated log hazard ratio, around scaled residuals centred (0 version 1.0.0), regression time natural spline confidence interval survival::plot.cox.zph(). plot_qq_survival(): axes set data (fixed 0 100 version 1.0.0). New write_survival_workbook(): Excel workbook one table per sheet (data summary, Kaplan-Meier table, hazard ratios, proportional hazards test, model status, fit statistics, parameters natural transformed scales rows covariance matrix, covariance matrices Cholesky factors, survival summary, predicted survival knots), print-ready model names. New write_survival_report(): Word report extrapolation survival data health technology assessment (overview, methods, data overview, diagnostics, standard parametric models spline-based extrapolation arm arms), figures without confidence intervals, smoothed hazard plots without fitted models, print-ready model names. styles come template package (inst/templates/report_template.docx: A4, Arial, numbered headings), document given template. Replaces Word export Shiny application version 1.0.0. New example dataset inst/extdata/fit_example.csv (two arms 300 patients) independent reference values tests (inst/validation/python/expected_fits.py, numpy scipy). Validation reproduction scripts: inst/validation/ compares package closed forms, survival::survreg(), rstpm2::stpm2() Python reference, checks Excel workbook Word report, estimates coverage confidence intervals simulation; inst/reproduce/ reproduces published results Jackson (2016) Royston Parmar (2002). Every comparison also run values package shifted (inst/validation/run_validation.R). Three vignettes (getting started, parametric spline models, validation) pkgdown website. license GPL (>= 2) instead MIT. broom, dplyr, magrittr, purrr, readr, rlang, tibble tidyr longer used; flexsurv (>= 2.3), ggplot2 (>= 3.4.0), officer, patchwork, splines writexl imported; haven, readxl, xml2, knitr rmarkdown (vignettes) suggested packages.
